Assigned Readings & Foundational Scholarship

Please consult the following foundational research on double-keying, error classification, and textual collation:

  • Haaf, Susanne, Frank Wiegand, and Alexander Geyken. "Measuring the Correctness of Double-Keying: Error Classification and Quality Control in a Large Corpus of TEI-Annotated Historical Text." Journal of the Text Encoding Initiative, Issue 4, 2013. DOI: 10.4000/jtei.739.
  • Griffitts, Troy A. Software for the Collaborative Editing of the Greek New Testament. PhD Thesis, Institute for Textual Scholarship and Electronic Editing (ITSEE), University of Birmingham, 2018. Open Access: etheses.bham.ac.uk/id/eprint/8440/.
